title: EXP-125 - Hello World Part 8 Phase 6b: Enabled When FX_CustomerID Not Blank on the Menu Buttons of FX_CustomerPortal, a Close/Reopen Readback and a Runtime Navigation Check
objective: Finish Hello World Part 8 Phase 6 (15:05-16:54) on FX_CustomerPortal (User scope): set Enabled When on the left menu buttons ButtonSignIn, ButtonHome and ButtonCart to the condition FX_CustomerID not equal to a blank literal (the tutorial's 'Customer ID less than or greater than blank'), built in the Edit Condition builder by editing its existing clause; read the three conditions back after a Designer close/reopen; then check at runtime, without saving anything, that the menu is disabled while Customer ID is blank, that Customer ID 1 plus the sign-in page's Sign In button (ButtonSignIn2) shows the home page tiles and enables the menu, and that the Cart, Home and Sign In menu buttons switch the visible page region. T1 gate; T2 to T4 one button each; T5 Designer readback; T6 runtime open; T7 sign-in; T8 menu navigation; T9 runtime close and final audit. Findings are observed only. The sign-in is a UI demonstration, not authentication.

Do not type, press F4 or click any button in T6. Screenshot: the opened Form showing the menu and the sign-in page.

Click the sign-in page's Sign In button (ButtonSignIn2, below the Customer ID edit; never the left menu's Sign In button) exactly once. Wait for the page to settle (at most 10 seconds), then record: any prompt or message verbatim (handle as in T6), the status bar, the console count, which page region is visible (expected the home page), what GridItems shows (tiles or rows, how many; item text of each visible tile), the header Customer ID display (expected 1) and each menu button's enabled state (expected enabled). Runtime navigation (T8): one click each, in this order, only on a menu button recorded as enabled: the left menu Cart button (expected: the cart page with its heading, GridOrders and the Checkout button; home and sign-in pages hidden), then the Home button (expected: the home page with the tiles), then the left menu Sign In button (expected: the sign-in page). After each click wait for the page to settle (at most 10 seconds) and record any prompt verbatim (handle as in T6), the console count, the status bar, which page region is visible, and the header Customer ID display. If a button is disabled, do not click it: record it and continue with the next one. Read GridOrders and the tiles only (no row or tile click, no scrolling except one view-only mouse-wheel scroll if a region is out of view, recorded). Screenshots: after each of the three clicks.
